name: RandomMaxx Artistify
description: I stumbled across a pretty interesting style combination of Loras and had a lot of fun with those. So I decided to create a merged lora that can be used as a styler that adds a unique style to Flux, making it way more artistic, hence the name for this lora. Many thanks to speach1sdef178 and blairesilver13 for their amazing work! Main Loras used are: Anime Niji Flux by speachsdef178 James Jean surreal illustration Flux by speachsdef178 Anime styler Flux by speachsdef178 Daubrez Painterly Style by blairesilver13 The lora works well in a range of 0.6 to 1.2. Most pictures in the gallery have been created with a strength of around 1.0. Please share your images in the model gallery! Super curious to see what you can come up with!
